title: Square Roots of Symplectic Matrices
summary: This paper characterizes the existence of real symplectic square roots for symplectic matrices. The decomposition of Wonenburger matrices with respect to their eigenvalues permits a partition of the problem into three primary cases. A symplectic matrix whose spectrum avoids the negative real axis is shown to always admit a real symplectic square root. For a negative hyperbolic matrix, such a root exists if and only if the half-dimension is even and the matrix itself is a $\diamond$-square.
